intro: Six screens on the way to paying. Two are ordinary payments, so refusing everything is not the answer.
reflection: Which cue would you have missed, and where does it appear in your own bank app?
scopeNote: Banks in the euro area have had to run the name check on euro transfers since 9 October 2025. Banks in EU countries outside the euro area add it by 9 July 2027; until then, the checks are yours to run.

lines: New payee: first payment to this IBAN

check.q: The invoice for your first driving lessons came by email, with this IBAN. You have not paid this school before. What do you do?

options.text: Send it. The name check is only a formality
options.why: Not possible means nobody has confirmed the name. The money follows the IBAN, whoever holds it.

options.text: Cancel for good. A failed check means a scam
options.why: Not possible is not a no match. It says only that no check was made.

options.text: Confirm the IBAN with the school first
options.why: Use a phone number, web address or front desk you find yourself, not the email. No check means no confirmation. Where your bank shows no name check at all, as some outside the euro area may until July 2027, do the same.

lines: You paid this account in March.

check.q: At training, the treasurer asked every member in person for the €45 season fee, to the account the club used in March. What do you do?

options.text: Cancel, since any transfer could be a scam
options.why: You heard it in person, and the check agrees. Refusing this one protects nothing.

options.text: Check the amount and the name, then confirm
options.why: An in-person request, a match and an account you paid before: an ordinary payment. Where a bank runs no name check yet, the other two still hold.

options.text: Ask the treasurer to confirm it by email first
options.why: You already heard it from her in person. An email adds a route that can be faked.

check.q: An online shop sells this phone at 60% below other shops, and its checkout offers instant transfer only. The name check says match. What do you do?

options.text: Stop, and pay this shop nothing
options.why: A price far below other shops and a transfer-only checkout are the tells. A match says whose account it is, not that the shop will deliver. Once sent, an instant transfer cannot be taken back.

options.text: Send it. The name check says match
options.why: A match proves whose account it is. It says nothing about whether a phone will arrive.

options.text: Send half now and the rest on delivery
options.why: Half sent to a shop that never delivers is still gone.
